general_information.Description: Managerial Accounting is a sub-area of accounting concerned with information needed to effectively plan and control company operations and make good business decisions. The overall objective of this course is to provide you with the concepts and tools needed to understand and effectively use managerial accounting information.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: To obtain an understanding of audio production and be able to use the basic vocabulary related to the term "audio"
Explain and interpret technical principles underpinning audio production workflows and equipment, relating them to use of digital audio production tools.
Relate aesthetic, design and psychoacoustics principles to the production of audio
Relate management, organisational and business theories to the process of producing audio and wider career development
Utilise testing methodologies to objectively measure, compare and calibrate audio production equipment.
Effectively and safely use of a variety of hardware and software tools with a basic working understanding of audio production equipment.
Demonstrate proficiency of the skills basic to audio production, including recording, mixing and interconnecting various pieces of equipment.

Use industry standard approaches to planning and organising productions such as: group/collaborative work; implementing and working within production workflows or pipelines and taking iterative or progressive approaches to production development
Collaborate in production teams and critique your peers work in a constructive manner
Be able to critically evaluate and reflect on own work and the methods used, then independently develop knowledge and skills in response.
Gain an understanding of how the skills of audio production relate to other forms of media productions.
